description.value: Haiyi Seafood Restaurant is a full-service Chinese seafood and dim sum destination on Main Street in Vancouver, offering an expansive menu of over 200 items spanning fresh seafood, roasted meats (soya chicken, charcoal grill pork jowl), clay pot rice, and signature tofu dishes. The restaurant supports multilingual ordering in English, Chinese, Korean, and Hindi, and takes reservations. Takeout and online pre-ordering are available through the Goopter platform.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an active Chinese seafood restaurant at 4818 Main St, Vancouver with dine-in and takeout service. The website's feature list explicitly names 'Wi-Fi' and 'Take Out', and the menu includes a 'Tofu & Vegetables' category suggesting vegetarian options. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, or water refill appears anywhere on the site or in OSM tags; the 'Parking: Street' entry on the website refers to car street parking only.
concerns: No bike parking or bike-friendly amenity information found on website or in OSM tags.

Website is hosted on the Goopter third-party ordering platform; subpages for privacy/terms show Goopter branding rather than the restaurant's own branding, though the main listing page is correctly branded.
OSM address uses 'Main Street' while website uses 'Main St' and adds postal code V5V 3R8 — minor formatting difference, not a true discrepancy.
